tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Use when the user asks to find a UK company by name or number. Returns matching companies with registration details. Accepts partial names (e.g., 'Tesco') or full company numbers (8-digit, zero-padded, e.g., '00445790').

query.description: Company name (partial or full) or 8-digit company number to search for

tools.name: get_company_profile
tools.description: Use when the user needs detailed information about a specific UK company — registered address, incorporation date, SIC codes, filing deadlines, company status. Requires a company_number (8-digit, zero-padded).

company_number.description: Companies House company number (8-digit, zero-padded, e.g. '00445790' or 'SC123456' for Scottish companies)

tools.name: get_officers
tools.description: Use when the user asks about a company's directors, secretary, or board composition. Returns current and resigned officers with appointment dates. Returns up to 100 results per page. Use the 'page' parameter (0-indexed) to fetch more if has_more is true.

company_number.description: Companies House company number (8-digit, zero-padded, e.g. '00445790')

page.description: Page number (0-indexed). Each page returns up to 100 officers.

tools.name: get_filing_history
tools.description: Use when the user asks about a company's recent filings, annual returns, or accounts history. Returns the most recent filings with dates and types. Returns up to 100 results per page. Use the 'page' parameter (0-indexed) to fetch more if has_more is true.

company_number.description: Companies House company number (8-digit, zero-padded, e.g. '00445790')

max_results.description: Number of filings to return (default 10, max 50). Ignored when page is specified.

page.description: Page number (0-indexed) for paginated access. Each page returns up to 100 filings. When set, max_results is ignored.

tools.name: get_psc
tools.description: Use when the user asks who owns or controls a company. Returns persons with significant control (25%+ ownership or voting rights).

company_number.description: Companies House company number (8-digit, zero-padded, e.g. '00445790')

tools.name: get_charges
tools.description: Use when the user asks about a company's mortgages, loans, or secured debt. Returns registered charges with lender details.

company_number.description: Companies House company number (8-digit, zero-padded, e.g. '00445790')

tools.name: check_company_health
tools.description: Use when the user wants a quick risk assessment of a UK company. Computes a 0-100 health score based on filing history, officer status, insolvency markers, and PSC compliance. Good for due diligence or supplier vetting.

company_number.description: Companies House company number (8-digit, zero-padded, e.g. '00445790')

tools.name: get_company_financials
tools.description: Use when the user asks about a company's financial performance — revenue, profit, assets, liabilities, or employee count. Parses the company's latest iXBRL annual accounts filed at Companies House.

company_number.description: Companies House company number (8-digit, zero-padded, e.g. '00445790' or 'SC123456' for Scottish companies)

tools.name: full_due_diligence
tools.description: Use when the user wants a comprehensive due diligence report on a UK company. Runs all checks in parallel — search, profile, health score, officers, ownership, and financials — in a single call. Saves 5-6 sequential tool calls.

company_name.description: Company name to search for (use this OR company_number)

company_number.description: Companies House company number (8-digit, zero-padded). Skip search if provided.

tools.name: verify_business_legitimacy
tools.description: Use when the user wants to verify a UK business is real and matches its public claims. Cross-checks a website against Companies House: registered name, registered office address, company status (active/dormant/dissolved), active officers, and LocalBusiness schema. Returns a 0-100 legitimacy score with itemized mismatches and evidence. Pure HTTP — no API key beyond Companies House.

url.description: Website URL to verify (homepage or contact page)

company_name.description: Override company to check against. If omitted, the tool tries to extract the legal name from the website (LocalBusiness schema, footer copyright, contact page) and search Companies House.

company_number.description: Direct Companies House number (8-digit). Skips name resolution. Use this OR company_name.
